profile.name: Anupam Das
profile.title: DVM, MS
profile.position: Research Assistant at Viral Genomics and Infection Dynamics Laboratory

education.description: Thesis: Molecular detection and complete genomic characterization of fowl adenovirus (FAdV) strains circulating in poultry in Bangladesh.
5-year professional veterinary program covering infectious disease pathology, epidemiology, clinical diagnostics, and diagnostic internship.

category1.title: In Vitro & Wet-Lab
category1.subtitle: Laboratory Benchwork & Viral Culture
bullets: [bullet] Viral Isolation & Culture: Embryonated Chicken Egg (ECE) inoculation, primary cell culture and continous cell culture maintenance, cytopathic effect (CPE) monitoring.
[bullet] Serology & Titration: Hemagglutination (HA) and HA Inhibition (HI) assays, viral infectivity titration (EID50, ELD50 calculations), indirect and sandwich ELISA assays.
[bullet] Molecular Assays: Viral DNA/RNA extraction, DNA quantification, DNA purification (gel), PCR, Reverse transcription-PCR, Real-time PCR, agarose gel electrophoresis, gel documentation.

category2.title: Computational & Bioinformatics
category2.subtitle: Genomic and evolutionary Analysis
bullets: [bullet] NGS Genome Assembly & Annotation: Genome assembly (SPAdes,FastQC, Trimmomatic, minimap, kraken2), gene prediction, genome annotation (Prokka, NCBI).
[bullet] Phylogenetics & Evolutionary Dynamics: IQ-TREE, RAxML, MEGA, BEAST, FigTree, iTOL.
[bullet] Recombination & Selection Pressure: RDP4/RDP5, PAML(codeml), Datamonkey server, hyphy
[bullet] Computational Tools: Linux shell scripting, Python & R data visualization (Elementary level).

aboutMe.title: Hi, This is Anupam
aboutMe.description: I am a veterinarian and microbiologist with research experience in molecular microbiology, virology, and pathogen genomics. My current research focuses on the molecular characterization and evolutionary dynamics of avian viruses, while my broader interests span infectious diseases, microbial genomics, host–pathogen interactions, and emerging pathogens.
